questions.text: Discuss logarithmic transformations for image enhancement. [6]

Medical X-ray image (8-bit) needs enhancement of bone structures in range [120, 200]. Apply gray level slicing for both approaches (with/without background suppression). i) Write the transformation functions [4] ii) Show the mapping for pixel values 100, 150 and 220 [4] iii) Sketch the transformation curves [3].
How many different shades of grey are possible in a 10-bit grayscale image? Show their numeric range. Illustrate the expression of intensity resolution of any gray image. [3]
How to generate an image Histogram? What does an image Histogram say? [3+3=6]
Explain the four basic types of intensity characteristics of an image and their corresponding histograms. [4]

3-bit 8x8 image, histogram counts {0:2, 1:3, 2:5, 3:6, 4:9, 5:12, 6:14, 7:13}. i) Sketch normalized histogram [2] ii) Compute and sketch the equalized histogram [2+4=6] iii) Sketch the transformation function curve [2].
What is the histogram of an image? Two images of size 20x20 with equal numbers of black (0) and white (1) pixels: are their histograms identical? Explain. [2+4=6]

4x5, 3-bit image [1,2,4,7,0,2,1,3,1,5,5,2,1,4,1,7,6,3,1,4]. i) Draw histogram [2] ii) Sketch normalized histogram [2] iii) Compute and sketch equalized histogram [2+4=6] iv) Sketch transformation function curve [2] v) Show the equalized output image [2].

What are the two principal approaches to image segmentation? Why is a Laplacian filter typically combined with a Gaussian smoothing filter (LOG operator) before performing edge detection in noisy environments? [4+2=6]
Boundary grid figure (anticlockwise). Compute the 8-directional chain code that is: i) invariant to the starting point [7] ii) invariant to both the starting point and rotation [7].
Define dilation and erosion in binary images. How do they affect object size and shape? [3]

Construct a 6x6 binary image A and a 3x3 structuring element B. Using fundamental morphological operations, formulate an edge detection algorithm for A with B, and demonstrate the procedure systematically with mathematical expressions. [7]
